description: A compact ruined temple centred on a single tall vine-clad archway, with mossy stone-brick tiers stepping down to a glazed-terracotta floor medallion. A more intimate companion to the large temple hall — good as a gateway landmark or a mid-delve shrine.

style_fit.rationale: Same mossy classical-ruin language as the temple hall but built around one striking standing arch, so it reads well as a threshold/gateway piece. Renders cleanly at 1.21.11; sky-lit roofless ruin.
